kirk_historian.text: Old St Peter's. Bishop Gilbert of Caithness is said to have founded a church here in the 1200s, and the kirk was added to and patched for six hundred years after.
Services stopped in the 1830s and the roof came off not long after. Look up. The sky makes a fine ceiling, if a damp one.
The kirkyard is full of Sinclairs and Gunns and Mackays. Read the stones and you've read the history of the county.
